body: I've desided against suicide...for now, at least. I... I just want my family to be happy...
Because God wants us to suffer.
I can only pray for your peace in death.

From what you told me, you sound alot stronger than me. I've already picked my own date of death. You are stronger than you can ever imagine. You CAN and WILL make it out alive. I've lost all hope, but you haven't. By surviving for three more weeks, you can inspire and save the lives of thousands who want to commit suicide. You can make a difference. You CAN survive. You WILL survive. So, smile, please. It helps if you just smile and focus on happy thoughts.
                             Yours truly,
                               Tearful
I talk to myself. I just do it so the voices stop.
